title: The cull rail advertises 'Keep best 1 (+0%)' from a curve it already knows is stale; pressing it always refuses
summary: The render-time/press-time asymmetry the verifier confirmed is gone in the working tree. A prior wave introduced CullOfferStatus / CullRecommendationOffer and the SessionReviewController.cullRecommendationOffer getter, which evaluates EVERY guard cullToRecommended() used to only apply at press time (population length mismatch, duplicate accepted paths, any population path no longer accepted, keepN >= population.length, predictedSnrGainPct <= 0). cullToRecommended() now switches on that same getter, so render and press can never diverge. The rail gates its pressable, quantified action on offer.isOfferable and renders a non-actionable 'Cull analysis out of date' / 'Keep-set already optimal' chip otherwise. Verified live, not just read: 5 full-wiring widget tests over a real controller + real in-memory DB, and both halves of the fix independently revert-proven.
evidence_file_line: packages/skotiq_app/lib/screens/session_review/widgets/sub_cull_rail.dart:289 - render-time gate: onCullToRecommended: _offer.isOfferable ? () => _cullToRecommended(_offer) : null  (HEAD had the defect verbatim at :274: `curve != null && curve.recommendation.keepN > 0`)

packages/skotiq_app/lib/screens/session_review/session_review_controller.dart:1536 - cullRecommendationOffer getter; :1567 gain/coverage gate `rec.keepN >= population.length || rec.predictedSnrGainPct <= 0`
packages/skotiq_app/lib/screens/session_review/session_review_controller.dart:1589-1600 - cullToRecommended() reads the same getter, so the press handler holds no guard of its own
packages/skotiq_app/lib/screens/session_review/widgets/sub_cull_rail.dart:503 and :515 - stale / alreadyOptimal render a SkotiqChip, never a 'Keep best N (+X%)' button
packages/skotiq_app/lib/screens/session_review/widgets/sub_cull_rail.dart:113-140 - the rail listens to the controller so an accept/reject re-stales the offer with no new curve
test: packages/skotiq_app/test/screens/session_review/sub_cull_rail_stale_curve_test.dart - 5/5 pass; full package dir `flutter test test/screens/session_review/` 78/78 pass; `dart analyze lib/screens/session_review test/screens/session_review` -> No issues found
revert_check: Severed the production wiring at sub_cull_rail.dart:289 (`_offer.isOfferable` -> `_offer.keepN > 0`, i.e. HEAD's condition): 4 of 5 tests fail with 'Found 1 widget with text containing Keep best ... none were expected'. Restored -> green.
Severed the controller half at session_review_controller.dart:1567 (dropped `|| rec.predictedSnrGainPct <= 0`): the '+0%' test fails. Restored -> green.
caveats: Not a fix by me: HEAD (59dec49c7) still contains the defective line; the fix is uncommitted working-tree work from an earlier wave recorded under a different title. My only edit was removing a now-unnecessary `dart:typed_data` import that a prior wave left in sub_cull_rail_download_test.dart, so `dart analyze` is clean on the directory.

Exhaustiveness: `cullToRecommended` / `cullRecommendationOffer` / the 'Keep best' label have exactly one production call site each (SubCullRail via workbench_view.dart:163) - no headless-API, mobile or web surface renders this action. ImprovementCurvePanel also quotes keepN/gainPct, but it plots the curve's own domain (`total = points.length`, its own recommendation) and offers no action, so it makes no promise it can refuse.
